about: M10 prelude (P10, plan §7.4 rule 15): the tool axis of TOOL CALL names the working plane (Z: XY), which is the tool axis the R8 role of a cycle's Q203 is on. A TOOL CALL without an axis keeps it; nothing else in a Klartext program sets the plane.

states.about: A speed change names no axis and keeps the plane.
